description: The City of Copenhagen publishes a 3D city model of buildings and terrain for the whole municipality through the Open Data DK portal. The dataset page read on 2026-09-28 says the model was created in 2013 and offers four files: the buildings in DGN, DWG and DXF formats and the terrain in DWG, each labelled with a CC BY licence. The page names the city's Bydata team as author, gives the temporal coverage as 2013 and the update frequency as never, and lists an e-mail contact for questions. Coverage is the Municipality of Copenhagen. Access is free, and the files are labelled CC BY. Caveats: the model is a 2013 snapshot that the city does not plan to update, so newer buildings are missing, and CAD formats need conversion before GIS or simulation use; the level of detail was not read. It supports digital twin and exposure studies, such as placing buildings on a terrain model for cloudburst flood or urban heat simulation in Copenhagen. Related records: Aarhus publishes a newer 3D city model, and Copenhagen's street trees are catalogued separately.
